# DayOfMind Additions
**Practical tools, smart enchantments and building blocks that feel like vanilla.**

[DayOfMind Additions](https://modrinth.com/mod/dayofmind-additions) is the companion mod to the **DayOfMind** modpack — a curated vanilla+ experience by [OxFaTech](https://oxfatech.de) — but it works standalone in any Fabric pack. It speeds up resource gathering, terraforming and farming, adds a full tool‑progression system, and rounds out your building palette, all without overcomplicating the base game.

## ⭐ New in 0.15 — the Tools Update
A complete tool rework: a **Harvester Scythe**, a tier‑upgrade system with the **Reforging Rune**, two signature **enchantments** (Wide Reach & Magnetism), the **Lodestar Charm** magnet with optional accessory‑slot support, and a dedicated **advancement tab**.

🎬 **See it in action** *(recorded on the earlier tools — the idea's the same!)*

[![Watch the DayOfMind Additions showcase on YouTube](https://img.youtube.com/vi/7UkGhGWrxFM/hqdefault.jpg)](https://youtu.be/7UkGhGWrxFM)

---

## ✨ Key Features

### 🛠️ Smart Tools
A family of tools that turn tedious jobs into a single click. Every tool comes in all six tiers (Wood → Netherite) and works with modded blocks too.

* **Terraformer Shovel** — excavates earth‑like blocks in an area, and toggles dirt ↔ dirt‑path (sneak to reverse).
* **Hammer** — mines stone‑like blocks in an area, and creates paths just like the shovel.
* **Prospector Pickaxe** — vein‑mines a whole ore deposit at once.
* **Lumberjack Axe** — fells an entire tree, and strips logs in an area.
* **Harvester Scythe** — right‑click to harvest & replant mature crops, mow grass/ferns/flowers, shear vines/leaves/cobwebs, cut sugar cane/bamboo/cactus, harvest melons & pumpkins, and till farmland — all context‑aware.

![The DayOfMind tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AcxzUn56/images/aa0ffcf0e8e975f56ad8d291955376fdb5e10955.png)
![Shovel feature](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AcxzUn56/images/884f12fefc2302b5c2527f68d67050cdbbca8f7e.gif)

![Harvester Scythe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AcxzUn56/images/dc5ca106f3eff963f2e6ffe42a996a2e01d37354.gif)

### ♻️ Tool Progression & Reforging
Your tools grow with you instead of being re‑crafted from scratch.

* **Durable by design** — every tool carries extra durability over its vanilla counterpart.
* **Reforging Rune** — a craftable smithing item that upgrades an **Iron or Gold** tool to **Diamond**, carrying its enchantments and wear across.
* **Netherite upgrades** — promote a Diamond tool to Netherite with a vanilla smithing template, exactly like vanilla gear.

![Reforging Rune upgrade — Iron/Gold → Diamond](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AcxzUn56/images/9744afa346bd307ceae20c6c4da774cbd72a801d.png)
![Reforging Rune upgrade — to Diamond](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AcxzUn56/images/4a9b98349838fe7ae8f1b825fd2ee096d9807be4.png)

### 🌟 Signature Enchantments
Available at the enchanting table and listed in the mod's own creative tab.

* **Wide Reach** *(I–II)* — widens the affected area of the radius tools (and the Lodestar Charm's pull).
* **Magnetism** *(I–II)* — sends the drops from blocks you mine or harvest **straight to you** (never a general vacuum). **Level II** also pulls in the experience. Works on the mod's tools and vanilla mining tools alike.

![Magnetism on the Prospector Pickaxe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AcxzUn56/images/df9e05a562c0242bececde19faeeb52122ff9291.gif)
![The Magics creative tab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AcxzUn56/images/383896f4363f8c6174967a8223e617bdd936a70d.png)

### 🧲 Lodestar Charm
A mystical trinket that draws nearby dropped items — and experience — to you.

* Works from your **off hand** out of the box.
* With an accessory mod installed (optional) — **[Ohmega](https://modrinth.com/mod/ohmega)** or **[Trinkets Updated](https://modrinth.com/mod/trinkets-updated)** — equip it in an accessory slot instead.
* **Enchantable** with Wide Reach to extend its pull radius.

![Lodestar Charm in action](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AcxzUn56/images/2786355138578bf86c746f8c865e614c60efeb7d.gif)
![Lodestar Charm equipped in an Ohmega slot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AcxzUn56/images/19606be9edf08877af0feb07875257e08f4c2bf4.png)

### 🏗️ Architectural Options
Expand your building palette with variants that inherit the look and behaviour of their base blocks.

* **Slabs, Stairs & Trapdoors** for a huge range of vanilla blocks — including trickier ones like dirt path, Crying Obsidian and Magma.
* **True to their base** — Crying Obsidian variants still weep tear particles, Magma variants still burn and form bubble columns in water, dirt‑path slabs/stairs keep their lower profile, and grass variants turn snowy under snowfall.
* **Lanterns** — small, large and redstone‑powered, in materials like Copper, Amethyst and Diamond (with copper weathering).
* **Redstone Chains** — conduct redstone power along their axis for compact, tidy wiring.
* **Grass Stairs & Slabs** — biome‑tinted, so they blend into the landscape.

![Redstone Chain and Lantern](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AcxzUn56/images/a83c49f94782224cb628566e3eeb91a776ebd55a.gif)

### 🌿 Nature & Quality of Life
* **Configurable Fast Leaf Decay** — quicker tree cleanup with adjustable timing.
* **Vanilla Shovel Tweak** — the plain shovel can toggle dirt ↔ path too (optional).
* **Consistent Block Effects** — every variant keeps the properties of its base block.
* **Craftable Name Tag** — craft name tags from string, a sign, paper and an iron nugget — no fishing or trading required.
* **In‑game config** — toggle the shovel tweak, tune the leaf‑decay speed, and manage translation downloads via [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) / MidnightLib.

![Name Tag recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AcxzUn56/images/b940357affbc23ea41bda63932a733eb5b0232a0.png)

### 🏆 Advancements
A dedicated **DayOfMind Additions** advancement tab guides you through crafting each tool family, forging the Reforging Rune, reaching Netherite, and building your first redstone circuit.

![The DayOfMind Additions advancement tab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/AcxzUn56/images/f63eecc76b62f14997d6d6ad8459886263029dfb.png)

## 🚀 Installation
1. Download the mod from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/dayofmind-additions) or [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dayofmind-additions).
2. Drop the `.jar` into your `mods` folder.
3. Make sure you also have **Fabric API**, **Fabric Language Kotlin** and **MidnightLib** for your Minecraft version.

**Optional companions:** [Ohmega](https://modrinth.com/mod/ohmega) or [Trinkets Updated](https://modrinth.com/mod/trinkets-updated) (an accessory slot for the Lodestar Charm), plus [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) and [Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade) — all supported automatically when present.

* ⭐ **We'll feature you** — drop your video in our [Discord](https://discord.gg/juxu5Jrrdk) and we'll link it on our pages.
